items.title: Bob Lovett Interview, 1949-04-01
items.q: You say that Art Hody sat in with you.

ctx.x: continuing their interest in... G-E-R-O-U-L-D. No, I have no idea what's happened to any of the others.
G-E-R-O-U-L-D. You say that Art Hody sat in with you. If I remember, Don Ewell used to occasionally.
G-E-R-O-U-L-D. Yeah, Don used to play with us quite often. In fact, I think we may have made some records which have become lost.
